_comment: Which knowledge-base findings, approved case facts and approved quotes the /ai-readiness page may cite. Edit here, then run `node scripts/readiness-evidence/sync.mjs` from a checkout inside the Vibrana hub (or with VIBRANA_HUB set) to refresh evidence-ledger.json. Findings must pass the hub ledger (verified, public or anonymized); case facts and quotes must appear verbatim in an engagement's Approved facts table or Approved quotes list. tests/readiness-page/evidence.test.ts checks every number and quote on the page against this snapshot.

facts: Calls reviewed for quality and compliance went from about 5% (monthly spot-check) to 100%
The PDF of FAQs became a knowledge base of 1,441 answers
One senior expert freed from QA and question-answering to train the floor
Two weeks on-site, in person; strategy run in parallel with building
20 years of one person's expertise made searchable and multilingual
Knowledge base of 261 real answers; personal data stripped before anything else happens
7 of their team trained to build with AI
"Up to 528 hrs saved per trained person, per year (estimated: 7 to 11 hrs a week x 48 weeks)". Always show it as an estimate with the arithmetic; the client estimated the hours
About 80% of the organization completed an AI readiness assessment in week one, across 20+ job functions
Pulse score 4.4 / 5 on "how the change connects to my day-to-day work"; almost two thirds answered 5
Payout automation projected to save about 720 hours a year
Monthly people-team newsletter cut from about 10 hours to 1
A shadow AI audit came first and surfaced unapproved tools and data flowing through AI systems with no policy behind it
quotes: Impressed and at the same time scared that you have a very similar understanding of what my perception is.
I realized I could just talk to this thing like a caveman and it would build it for me. I didn't need to know how it all worked.
